name: SaneBox
summary: Email triage that moves low-priority mail out of the inbox and works with any provider. The honest catch: you are paying monthly to filter mail that modern email clients increasingly sort for free.
best_for: heavy-email professionals drowning in a cluttered inbox who want AI triage that works across any mail client
skip_if: your inbox is manageable or your mail client's built-in filtering already handles it: you don't need to pay for this
honest_knock: It works with any email provider, which is a genuine advantage over the built-in tools in Gmail and Outlook. But you are paying monthly to filter mail that modern clients increasingly sort for free. The value is real only if your inbox is overwhelming and native filters are not cutting it. Price it on the plan you would actually keep: the headline rate is billed yearly, and month to month the same Snack plan is $9.49 rather than $5.42.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Snack (1 email account, 2 features) · per month billed annually ($65 a year)
pricing.notes: (re-read 21 November 2026 from the plan data that sanebox.com/pricing embeds for its client-side price cards) Three plans, billed yearly or month to month. The two-year option we recorded on 24 September 2026 (Snack $4.54 a month, $109 every 2 years) is no longer offered: the served page now carries a flag that hides it and no two-year price for any plan. Snack $5.42/mo billed $65 a year, or $9.49 month to month: 1 email account and 2 of the Sane features. Lunch $9.08/mo ($109 a year) or $15.99: 2 accounts and 6 features. Dinner $26.58/mo ($319 a year) or $42.99: 4 accounts, every listed feature, and the AI features SaneDrafts, SaneSummary and Digest Plus. The page states the yearly saving as 43% on Snack and Lunch and 38% on Dinner against twelve monthly payments. The free trial is 7 days. On 24 September the page also offered education, non-profit and government buyers another 25% off on request during the trial; that line is not in the page served on 21 November, so ask before counting on it.
